title: GuestMessagingPermissionDocument
description: Server-maintained guest-owned read view of one WhatsApp permission row on the guest's messaging settings page: the guest's Catch row (id catchpref_{uid}) or one organizer row (the organizerCommunicationPreferences id). preference is exactly what listParticipantMessagingPreferences summarizes for that sender, including receipt validation. Written by triggers on the preference and receipt collections. Never an endpoint, consent copy or receipt contents, and never consent or dispatch authority; withdrawals still go through withdrawParticipantMessagingPermission, fenced on receiptId.
x-owner: Guest messaging permission projector (messaging guest messaging permission triggers)

organizerId.description: The sending organizer; null on the Catch row.
